title: Exam dates
lead: Upcoming ADA exam dates, how to register, the exam fees, and when results arrive.

postpartum.title: Postpartum Doula exam
postpartum.intro: Exams are held at {address}. The exam fee is {fee}, paid to ADA.

before.title: Before you register
before.whoValue: Candidates who have completed an ADA-approved training program.
before.howValue: Your training provider guides you through registration. You can also register with ADA directly at <mail>{email}</mail> or <tel>{phone}</tel>.
before.languageValue: Choose {languages} when you register. All exam materials are provided in the language you choose.
before.idValue: Bring a valid government-issued photo ID on exam day. <link>Exam day and ID</link>

birth.title: Birth Doula exam
birth.datesValue: Birth Doula exam sessions are scheduled after each training cohort. <link>Contact us for the next date.</link>
birth.programValue: The ADA Birth Doula Program runs cohorts on a rolling basis. <link>ADA Birth Doula</link>

fees.title: Fees
fees.intro: Exam fees are paid to ADA. Fees for the training program are set by each training provider.
fees.caption: ADA exam fees
fees.examWhen: Covers the written and the practical exam. Paid to ADA.
fees.retakeWhen: Each new attempt after a result below {pass}/{max}. Wait at least {days} days after your attempt.
fees.renewalWhen: Renews your certificate for {years, plural, one {another year} other {another # years}}.
fees.assistanceWhen: Need-based and merit-based scholarships for training and exam fees. <link>Scholarships</link>

results.title: Results
results.whenValue: By email, about {days} business days after your exam.
results.resultValue: A score out of {max} and a level: Highly Proficient ({high} and above), Proficient ({pass}–{highBelow}) or Not Proficient (below {pass}). The pass mark is {pass}/{max}.
results.passValue: ADA issues your certificate, valid for {years, plural, one {# year} other {# years}}, with a number in the form {format}, and publishes your record in the ADA registry.
results.failValue: Register for a later date. The retake fee is {fee}, and you can retake the exam {days} days or more after your attempt.
results.lookup: Look up a record in the registry

policies.title: Policies and help
policies.examDayDescription: What to bring, where the exam is held, and how each part runs.
policies.conductDescription: The principles every ADA-certified doula agrees to.
policies.contactDescription: Write to ADA about registering or about your exam date.
